WITH vti_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        vendregistry,
        vendsucccount,
        vendtxcount,
        venddisputecount,
        vendrate,
        (CAST(vendsucccount AS numeric) / vendtxcount) * 100 
        - (CAST(venddisputecount AS numeric) / vendtxcount) * 50 
        + (vendrate * 5) AS vti
    FROM vendors
),
vnc_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        v.vendregistry,
        m.sizecluster,
        v.vti,
        (COUNT(DISTINCT v.mktref) * 5) 
        + (CAST(v.vendtxcount AS numeric) / 50) 
        + (v.vti * 0.1) 
        - (1 - CASE m.sizecluster 
            WHEN 'Small' THEN 1 
            WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 
            WHEN 'Large' THEN 3 
            WHEN 'Mega' THEN 4 
            ELSE 0 END) * 10 AS vnc
    FROM vendors v
    JOIN markets m ON v.mktref = m.mktregistry
    GROUP BY v.vendregistry, m.sizecluster, v.vti, v.mktref, v.vendtxcount
)
SELECT 
    vendregistry,
    sizecluster,
    ROUND(CAST(vti AS numeric), 2) AS vti,
    ROUND(CAST(vnc AS numeric), 2) AS vnc
FROM vnc_calc
WHERE vnc > 50
ORDER BY vnc DESC;
